title: Louvre Palace
limitations: Cour Carrée, Cour Lefuel and the Cour Napoléon plaza stay open. Covered courts use reconstructed skylights and a low golden canopy positioned from mapped roof outlines.
The exterior follows the ordinary aerial and Cour Carrée photographs. Stone carving, sculpture, internal galleries and exact masonry joint placement are approximated or omitted.
Foundations and sill heights use the standard Terrarium field. The coarse urban elevations obscure portions of the lowest façade band, especially in Cour Carrée.
